name: Bot Discord/Telegram premium (for enterprises)
notes: Enterprise variant emphasizes SLA, audit logs, SSO/SAML. Proxy TIER0 via GitHub Search for enterprise chatbot frameworks (Botpress/Rasa Enterprise forks). Official targets: Microsoft Teams Graph API, Salesforce Service Cloud. Monetization via annual enterprise license. Zero-capital validation uses self-hosted Docker + LDAP mock; real deploy requires VPS but can start on free tier for PoC.
